title: fix(scenarios): make the crm control card agree with its own personas
body:
Fixes #30770
epic:#3600#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjPXwX1YfHyKJUh4agu

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:修正 `crm_account_with_contacts` 对照卡片里四个与自身 persona 设定矛盾的写操作(移动联系人、删除确认、新建联系人、邮箱校验),卡片的种子数据、问题和计算出的答案都不变。
- 为什么改:卡片原本让 sdr 去改它看不见的记录、写它看不见的字段,忠实的构建只会拒绝,于是评分时卡片永远判错;现在每个操作都落在执行者能触及的范围内。
- 风险与回滚:只动一张 QA 场景卡片和私有测试包的测试,不发布任何包;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`docs/qa/scenarios/crm_account_with_contacts.json`(operations 段),`packages/qa/scenarios/test/runner/units.test.ts`(改名后的操作断言)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios test`,预期 15 个测试文件、203 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的:决定本卡「预防同类问题」的那一半(loader 拒收规则,已在暂存分支上实现并验证)要不要扩大文件面合入,它同时会拒收另外三张卡片里的五个同类操作,详见下方 Acceptance notes。

## What changes

Every operation of `docs/qa/scenarios/crm_account_with_contacts.json` now acts on what its acting persona can reach. The card's intent per operation is kept; seed rows, questions and computed truths are unchanged.

| Before | After | Why this fix and not the other |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `attach_dee`: `sdr` edits `ct4` (`account: null`, outside `sdr`'s scope `contact.account.owner = u_sam`), expected `applied` | `move_eli`: `sdr` re-parents `ct5` (Eli Moss) from Bitworks (`ac3`) to Acme (`ac1`), both owned by `u_sam`; still `applied`, `auditActor: sdr` | The operation exists for the `audit_actor` guardrail ("Re-parenting the contact is audited with the signed-in user as its actor"), which needs an `applied` write. A refused overstep would have dropped that guardrail's only operation. No unattached contact can ever be in `sdr`'s scope (a null account resolves to no owner), so the edit moves to an in-scope re-parent. `ct5` stays in scope after the move. |
| `contact_bad_email`: `sdr` creates a contact with a malformed `email`, expected `VALIDATION_FAILED`, but `sdr` hides `contact.email` | Acts as `partner_user`, writes `{ full_name, email }` only, still expected `VALIDATION_FAILED` | The `write_validation` guardrail asserts the form's validation error. `partner_user` hides only the `account` object, so it can edit `email`. It writes no `account` lookup, so it never references the object it must not read. The live reading the runner recorded (`VALIDATION_FAILED`, "Email must be a valid email address") stays the expected answer. |
| `remove_chen`: `sdr` is asked to delete `ct3` (Shopwell, owned by `u_tia`, outside `sdr`'s scope), expected `pending_confirmation` | `remove_ben`: `sdr` is asked to delete `ct2` (Ben Ode, Acme), still `pending_confirmation` | Same defect class as `attach_dee`: an agent acting as `sdr` cannot even find Chen Li. |
| `add_contact`: `sdr` creates a contact writing `email`, a field `sdr` hides, expected `applied` | Writes `{ full_name, account }`; the created row is read back by `where: { full_name }` | Same defect class as `contact_bad_email`: a faithful build refuses a write to a field the persona must not read. |

`remove_chen` and `add_contact` were not named on the card. The held loader rule (below) found them, and they are fixed here under the bounded in-place rule: same defect class, mechanical, in the file this claim holds, same gate family.

Tests that named the old operation ids now use the new ones (`test/refusals.test.ts`, `test/runner/units.test.ts`, `test/runner/orchestrate.test.ts`, `test/score/entry.test.ts`). The orchestrate test's fake built artifact now grants `partner_user` `allowCreate` on `contact`, to match the operation it now runs. The runner counts stay 8 questions / 9 persona turns / 5 operations / 2 personas.

## Tests

At `9bfc83d2`:

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios test`: Test Files 15 passed (15), Tests 203 passed (203); lock `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios typecheck` (`tsc --noEmit`): exit 0, after `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/scenarios^...' build` (exit 0).
- eslint (`--no-inline-config`) on the four changed test files: exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

**The class guard (the card's "prevent the class" ask) is held, not in this PR.** It is statically decidable, and it is implemented on `claude/issue-30770-loader-reach-held` @ `82b1acd8` (one commit on top of this branch). The loader refuses an operation whose declared outcome contradicts its acting persona:

1. op object hidden from the persona: requires `refused` + `PERMISSION_DENIED`.
2. target row outside the persona's row scope: requires `refused` + `RECORD_NOT_FOUND`. A by-id write on a row the caller cannot read is answered not-found before any field or validation gate (plugin-security authz middleware, the `callerCannotReadAddressedRow` branches).
3. a written field hidden from the persona: requires `refused` + `PERMISSION_DENIED`. The field-write gate (`computeForbiddenFieldWrites`) runs before validation.

Codes go through `ErrorCode.parse` (ADR-0112). Path scopes are no obstacle: the loader already resolves relation paths through the seed rows (`resolverFor`, the same resolver the persona truths use). Proof on the held branch: `test/refusals.test.ts` gains 5 refusal cases plus a control. With the rule: 48/48 pass. With `loader.ts` restored to this branch's version (ablation): 43 pass / 5 fail, exactly the 5 new cases. Restore verified by blob hash `4310a418…` equal to HEAD.

Why held: the same rule also refuses five operations in three cards outside this claim's file surface, so `library.test.ts` is red on the held branch:

- `invoice_with_line_items` op 0 `add_line` and op 3 `line_without_product`: `sales_rep` writes `invoice_line.unit_price`, which it hides.
- `project_with_tasks` op 0 `add_task` and op 3 `task_without_title`: `contractor` writes `task.estimate_hours`, which it hides.
- `travel_expense` op 4 `employee_approves_colleague`: target `as_112_1` is outside `employee`'s `approval_step` scope, so the rule wants `RECORD_NOT_FOUND`, while the card declares `PERMISSION_DENIED`. If an approval decision travels through an approval door rather than a by-id data update, that card's code may be right and the rule's row-scope arm should not apply to it. This one wants a ruling, not a mechanical fix.

What the held rule deliberately does not decide (the platform's answer depends on the build's write policy, not on the card): a create whose values place the new row outside the persona's scope, an update whose values move the row out of scope, and a lookup value naming a row outside scope or of a hidden object.

`packages/qa/scenarios/README.md` still shows `gradeCardOperation(card, 'remove_chen', observed)` as an example. It is outside this claim's file surface; it is a one-token follow-up (`remove_ben`).

No changeset: `@objectstack/scenarios` is private and `docs/qa/` ships in no package, so this PR carries `skip-changeset`.

## Verification

<details><summary>Derived gate families: 50 derived, 49 run exit 0, 1 NOT MEASURED</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --commands` at `9bfc83d2` (change set: 5 paths against merge base `612468cc2`). Every family exits 0 except:

- `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` :: exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET (reads built output of 61 packages this run did not build). NOT MEASURED; CI's Lint & Repo Gates runs it.

`--ran` reconciliation with every exit recorded: "50 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 49 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED (1 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)".

</details>

<details><summary>Held loader rule: what it reports on the current library</summary>

On this branch's card, plus the held `loader.ts`, the crm card loads clean; before this PR's card fix it answered four refusals (ops 0 to 3 of this card). The other five refusals are listed above.

</details>
